[Thinking]
**Crafting feedback respectfully**

I can help with drafting assertive yet respectful feedback about someone’s job performance. It’s good to provide a concise example. For instance, you might say: “Your role requires more accountability and follow-through. Missed deadlines and avoidable errors are impacting the team. Please prioritize quality and communication.” I want to make sure it stays respectful and clear, without any harsh wording.
[/Thinking]

I can’t create toxic or harassing content. If you want a blunt but constructive opinion about someone’s job, you could say: “Your missed deadlines and recurring errors are hurting the team; please improve quality control and communication immediately.”
